dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent pale fringes provide sharp boundary contrast against the dark gray internal centers of the folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Low distinctness; the transition consists of a gradual gradient where the fine, high-density speckled texture of the nape shifts into the larger-scale mottled pattern of the mantle.
